'''Sareitha Tomares''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].

== Appearance ==
Sareitha was a dark [[Tairen]] with inquisitive brown eyes and a square face. She looks slightly older than [[Nynaeve]]. 

==Strength and Abilities==
Sareitha is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|low average]] strength for an Aes Sedai, with a [[One Power]] level of {{opsl|32}}. She would be unable to [[Traveling|Travel]] without linking with another channeler.

==History==
Sareitha was 35 years old, she was born in [[965 NE]] and went to the [[White Tower]] in [[980 NE]]. After ten years as [[Novice]] and eight as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the [[shawl]] in the year [[998 NE]]. 

She was still too new to the shawl to have the ageless look, which she sometimes plainly wished for. She had a single [[Warder]], [[Ned Yarman]]. 

==Activities==
=== Ebou Dar ===
She was allied with the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|Salidar Aes Sedai]].

She was sent to [[Ebou Dar]] as part of the embassy from [[Salidar]] to [[Tylin Quintara Mitsobar]], the Queen of [[Altara]]. While inside to [[Tarasin Palace]] in Ebou Dar, she faced off against the [[Elaida a'Roihan's White Tower|White Tower embassy]] as to whether [[Matrim Cauthon]] should be returned to the [[White Tower]].

When [[Elayne Trakand]] discovered the secret of the [[Kin]], Sareitha acted as the [[Seat of Rebuke]] in [[Merilille Ceandevin]]'s trial against Elayne.

She [[Traveling|Traveled]] with the the rest of the group led by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and Elayne from Ebou Dar to the Kin's [[farm]] with the [[Bowl of the Winds]]. Sareitha made it known that she feels Aviendha's name should be in the book of novices. She felt the Kin cannot be trusted because some of them claim to be a hundred years older or more than any known living Aes Sedai. She didn’t believe that can be possible and so didn’t trust them. She then journeyed to [[Andor]] with the rest of the group.

=== To Caemlyn ===
She moved through the city with Elayne Trakand when Elayne was out in [[Caemlyn]] greeting the people. She was the only Aes Sedai who thought that [[Doilin Mellar]] acted as a hero by rescuing Lord [[Luan Norwelyn]]'s men, even though Luan had not yet declared his support for Elayne. Perhaps this reflects her relative youth when compared with the other Aes Sedai.

In the [[Blue Reception Room]] in the [[Royal Palace of Andor|Caemlyn Palace]], Sareitha and [[Careane Fransi]] threatened the mercenary captains present about the power of the White Tower in order to help Elayne bring them under control.

Sareitha was killed by [[Chesmal Emry]] in Caemlyn when Elayne and the other Aes Sedai discovered them at [[Lady Shiaine]]'s house on Full Moon Street.
